hypothesis: The DEF-W57-006 outage is NOT a lab-fabric fault. The vSwitch, subnet, image pin, emitted profile and both live guests are healthy; the fault is isolated to the single 'compute02' VM object, and the only in-protocol remedy (lab/lab-reset.ps1 -> Start-VM, equivalently lab/lab-up.ps1:178) is refused by the Hyper-V management plane with an AUTHORIZATION error, not a not-found or timeout error. The blocker is therefore unavailable operator authority, not a repository, product, test or orchestration defect.
